```artifact
Feature: Lab Request Management and Patient Consultation

  Scenario: Lab requests are routed to the Laboratory
  Given a valid patient pincode
  When a lab request is submitted
  Then it should be routed to the Laboratory

  Scenario: Lab personnel make appointments and perform home collection
  Given lab personnel with an appointment
  When they perform home collection
  Then the lab request should be submitted

  Scenario: Patients upload reports
  Given a patient with up to 5 reports
  When they upload reports
  Then the reports should be accepted

  Scenario: Consultation request is routed to a specialist
  Given a consultation request
  When it is routed to a specialist
  Then the specialist should receive the request

  Scenario: Machine Learning Algorithm assists in diagnosis
  Given a doctor with symptoms
  When the machine learning algorithm assists
  Then the doctor should receive a prediction

  Scenario: Doctor accepts or modifies diagnosis
  Given a doctor with a diagnosis
  When the doctor accepts or modifies the diagnosis
  Then the diagnosis should be updated

  Scenario: Doctor performs diagnosis
  Given a doctor with a consultation request
  When the doctor performs the diagnosis
  Then the diagnosis should be completed


  Examples:
  | Patient Pincode | Lab Request Status | Report Size | Specialist | Diagnosis Prediction | Diagnosis Status |
  | valid          | submitted          | <=1MB       | specialist | prediction          | updated          |
  | invalid         | not submitted       | >1MB        | specialist | no prediction       | no update       |
  | valid          | not submitted       | <=1MB       | specialist | prediction          | no update       |
  | invalid         | submitted          | <=1MB       | specialist | no prediction       | updated          |
  | valid          | submitted          | >1MB        | specialist | prediction          | updated          |

```
